nodes.check: The facade parses the app slug, version, bindings, and consent exception scopes, composing caller-supplied tree references under the active tenant before authorization.
ITenantContextResolver resolves an initialized active tenant.
LatticeAccessGateEnforcement authorizes LatticeOperation.AppInstall on LatticeScope.ClusterWideTreeId with no key filter.
The call is GetCapabilitiesAsync.
Authorization succeeded before any registry, source, or activation status metadata is read or mutated.

terminals.outcome: The facade reads or mutates the caller tenant's app registry, source metadata, consent, or activation pipeline.
The advisory capability probe reports all app-control verbs granted; if authorization throws, it reports none.
The call is denied before app existence, consent, bindings, or activation state are disclosed.
The call fails as invalid input before any control-plane read or write.
The call fails closed because the active tenant cannot be resolved or validated.

decision_trees.fail_closed: Every app-control verb gates on AppInstall before reading registry, source, consent, bindings, or activation status; GetCapabilities returns a default-deny probe rather than granting authority.

nodes.check: The rule id starts with LatticeAppRuleIds.Prefix (app:).
LatticeAccessGateContext.IsSystemOrigin is true before the store enters its own system-origin scope.

terminals.outcome: The policy store continues to ordinary rule authoring validation and persistence or deletion.
PutRuleAsync or RemoveRuleAsync throws LatticeAppOwnedRuleException before any lookup, write, or delete.

decision_trees.fail_closed: Direct operator edits of app-owned rule ids are rejected before persistence or existence checks; only system-origin app reconciliation may replace them.

nodes.check: Every role operation is inside the installed AppCapabilityCeiling.AllowedOperations after excluding scopeless Telemetry and AppInstall.
Each role scope is structural for the app or covered by an approved exception scope; reserved, system, tenant-qualified, and cluster-wide sentinel scopes are not grantable exceptions.
Every supplied binding names a declared role and maps it to a non-empty membership group id.
The compiler emits deterministic Allow rules with group subjects and app:{slug}: rule ids, then activation replaces the app-owned stored set for that tenant.

terminals.outcome: No compiled rules are emitted or stale grants are withdrawn by activation fail-closed handling, depending on failure kind.
The compiled group rules become ordinary authorization rules enforced by the shared access gate.

decision_trees.fail_closed: A manifest, binding, or ceiling mismatch fails activation rather than clamping or partially granting; withdrawn rules are removed before new grants are written.

nodes.check: A restore target tree is explicitly supplied, or can be derived from the catalog or sink manifest.
An explicit caller target is composed under the active tenant; a manifest-derived target is already effective and is not recomposed.
No target can be resolved, so authorization falls back to the reserved backup catalog tree.
BackupAccessAuthorizer authorizes LatticeOperation.Restore over the resolved target scope or catalog fallback before restore, cold restore, rebuild, scrub, or revert touches data.

terminals.outcome: The restore, cold restore, catalog rebuild, catalog scrub, or revert operation proceeds.
The operation is denied before the restore engine, sink, or catalog mutation path is reached.
The operation is denied by active-tenant composition or backup tenant isolation before data is touched.

decision_trees.fail_closed: Restore authorization is total: absence of a manifest target falls back to Restore on the catalog tree instead of skipping the gate, and tenant isolation denials are non-disclosing probes.

nodes.check: Method starts with /orleans.lattice.api.apps/.
Method is GetAuthScheme with the auth-scheme request shape.
The bound unary RPC and request type classify to a known LatticeAppsApiOperation on the server.
LatticeAppsApiGrpcOptions.RequireAuthorization is true.
ILatticeAppsApiAuthorizer.IsAuthorizedAsync returns true for the server-classified operation and asserted slug.

terminals.outcome: The gRPC request reaches the app-control service, which stamps credential and active tenant and then applies the facade AppInstall gate.
The unauthenticated GetAuthScheme discovery call returns only configured public scheme descriptors.
The interceptor passes the call through unchanged because the method belongs to another service.
The call fails with gRPC status PermissionDenied before the facade is invoked.

decision_trees.fail_closed: DenyAppsApiAuthorizer is the default, unknown or streaming app-service methods are rejected, and operation classification comes from the bound RPC and request shape rather than caller-supplied data.

terminals.outcome: The request proceeds.
The interceptor passes the call through unchanged because the method belongs to another service.
The call fails with gRPC status PermissionDenied.

decision_trees.fail_closed: DenyAllAuthApiAuthorizer is the default and unknown methods map to Unknown.

decision_trees.fail_closed: DenyAllBackupApiAuthorizer is the default and unrecognised methods map to Unknown.

nodes.check: Method targets the live push, remote snapshot, or saga replication gRPC service.
LatticeReplicationSecurityOptions.RequireAuthentication is true.
Metadata contains x-lattice-replication-secret.
IReplicationSecretProvider.IsAcceptedAsync accepts the presented secret.
Call is a saga control RPC.
Origin header or coordinator cluster id is a non-empty key in LatticeReplicationGrpcOptions.Peers.
Call is Push, ExchangeContentManifest, or GetPeerHighWaterMark, which key the durable per-origin high-water mark by a body-declared OriginClusterId.
The x-lattice-replication-origin header is absent or blank, or ordinally equals the body OriginClusterId.

terminals.outcome: The request proceeds.
The interceptor passes the call through unchanged because the method belongs to another service.
The call fails with gRPC status PermissionDenied.
The call fails with gRPC status Unauthenticated.

decision_trees.fail_closed: Authentication is required by default; missing secrets are Unauthenticated, non-matching secrets are PermissionDenied, and saga control also requires an authorized peer origin; a peer may only advance or read the high-water mark of its own stamped origin.

The call fails with gRPC status PermissionDenied.

nodes.check: Method starts with /orleans.lattice.api.treeadmin/.
Method is GetAuthScheme.
LatticeTreeAdminApiGrpcOptions.RequireAuthorization is true.
ILatticeTreeAdminApiAuthorizer.IsAuthorizedAsync returns true for the primary target.
Request names a second caller-supplied tree id distinct from the primary target.
ILatticeTreeAdminApiAuthorizer.IsAuthorizedAsync returns true for the secondary target.

terminals.outcome: The request proceeds.
The unauthenticated GetAuthScheme discovery call proceeds without authorization.
The interceptor passes the call through unchanged because the method belongs to another service.
The call fails with gRPC status PermissionDenied.

decision_trees.fail_closed: DenyTreeAdminApiAuthorizer is the default; unrecognised methods map to Unknown and every caller-supplied tree target is authorized.

nodes.check: Subject id is in BootstrapAdministrators.
Tree is reserved auth, tenant-admin capability, tenant registry, or * sentinel.
Compiled policy has an explicit matching allow.
Write targets a strict-consistency tree with an unmet required policy epoch.
PolicyEvaluator returns allow or filtered allow.
Tenancy is active and tenant isolation denies the request.

terminals.outcome: The request proceeds.
The request is denied.
Denied: a control-plane namespace without a bootstrap administrator or an explicit matching allow, independent of DefaultEffect.

decision_trees.fail_closed: Control-plane namespaces deny independently of DefaultEffect unless bootstrap or explicit allow applies.

nodes.check: All-trees grants are enabled and the * bucket has a matching deny.
The target tree bucket has a matching rule.
All-trees grants are enabled and the * bucket has a matching allow.
DefaultEffect is Allow.

terminals.outcome: The request proceeds.
The request is denied.
The matched rule effect (Allow or Deny) for the specific tree is the decision.

decision_trees.fail_closed: DefaultEffect defaults to Deny and control-plane namespaces do not consult the all-trees tier.

nodes.check: The app MCP surface has providers plus registry projection, app source, and access gate collaborators.
The caller's credential and asserted active tenant resolve to a tenant context.
The registry snapshot has an enabled app install whose ceiling is pinned to its installed version.
The manifest resolves and every declared tool pairs exactly with one provider implementation under a non-reserved slug.

The access gate returns an unfiltered allow for every operation of the tool's declared role on at least one resolved scope for the caller subject; a key-filtered allow never holds an operation, on a prefix scope as on a tree scope.
The shared MCP coarse authorizer admits the namespaced tool name for this HTTP context.

terminals.outcome: The namespaced app tool is advertised; invocation re-runs the same role decision against the current registry before calling the implementation under the caller credential.
The app tool is absent from tools/list and therefore unreachable from tools/call; if a stale session invokes it, the namespaced tool throws an authorization McpException.

decision_trees.fail_closed: A missing collaborator, unvalidated tenant, disabled app, unpinned ceiling, bad tool pairing, lost role grant, or MCP coarse-authorizer denial withholds the app tool and the invocation path re-checks current state; a key-filtered allow does not hold a role operation.

nodes.check: LatticeApiMcpOptions.RequireAuthorization is true.
ASP.NET Core endpoint authorization authenticates the caller.
The MCP credential bridge resolves a non-null LatticeCredential for the session.
ILatticeApiMcpPermissionResolver grants at least one facade group from effective permissions.
A registered ILatticeApiMcpToolGroup contributes the requested group.
The session access set contains the group required by LatticeApiMcpGroupCapabilityMap.

The permission resolver carries no operation detail, or the granted operations intersect ILatticeApiMcpToolGroup.RequiredOperationsFor(toolName); the data group requires Write, Delete, RangeDelete, CrdtApply, AtomicWrite or BulkLoad for each mutating data tool and its coarse group mask otherwise.
Requested data mutation tool was contributed by AddDataTools(enableWrites: true), or the requested tool is not a data mutation.
McpToolAuthorizationGate resolves HttpContext and ILatticeApiMcpAuthorizer returns true.

terminals.outcome: The session is offered only the capabilities tool.
The session is offered no tools.
ASP.NET Core endpoint authorization rejects the HTTP request before MCP handling.
The tool invocation fails with an authorization McpException.
The tool is not listed for the session.
The tool does not exist on the server.
The caller credential and active tenant are stamped and the tool handler runs, subject to the facade access gate.

decision_trees.fail_closed: The endpoint requires authentication by default, DenyAllMcpAuthorizer denies by default, missing HttpContext or authorizer denies, unauthenticated sessions get no tools, and data write tools are absent unless explicitly enabled, and a mutating data tool withheld by the per-tool minimum is unreachable at tools/call because the session tool collection serves both.

nodes.check: The caller rule effect is Allow.
The rule scope TreeId equals LatticeScope.ClusterWideTreeId.
rule.Operations intersects the group capability mask.
rule.Operations with the cluster-wide-only bits (LatticeOperation.Telemetry and LatticeOperation.AppInstall) masked out intersects the group capability mask.

terminals.outcome: The tool group is advertised to the session; discovery is not an authorization decision and the call-time gate re-checks every invocation.
The rule contributes nothing; the next rule is evaluated, and a group no rule grants is not advertised.

decision_trees.fail_closed: Deny rules are not consulted at discovery and stay the call-time gate job; a tree-scoped rule never confers the scopeless Telemetry or AppInstall capability, for group discovery or for per-tool minimums.

nodes.check: LatticeActiveTenantContext is active with a non-null tenant that is not the reserved default tenant.
An ITenantRegionVisibilityResolver is registered and IsActive.
An ITenantContextResolver is registered.
ITenantContextResolver resolves the current tenant and it equals the asserted tenant.

terminals.outcome: The catalog advertises the current region alone with no tenantScope annotation; the asserted value is never echoed.

The catalog advertises the current region plus peers in the tenant allowed-union-resident set, annotated with the validated tenant; standing that cannot be established degrades to the current region alone.
The catalog advertises the full routing topology, subject to region identity verification.

decision_trees.fail_closed: A tenant-asserted call whose assertion does not validate, or whose standing cannot be established, never falls back to the full routing topology.

nodes.check: LatticeSystemOrigin.IsActive is true.
An ILatticeAccessGate is registered.
ILatticeAccessGate.AuthorizeAsync for LatticeOperation.Telemetry on LatticeScope.ClusterWideTreeId returns Allowed.
The allow decision carries a KeyFilter.
The tool is lattice_telemetry_query_range and TelemetryRangeGuardrails.TryValidateRange rejects the range.

For query, query_range, and metric_metadata, TelemetryMetricAccessPolicy (via TelemetryQueryAuthorizer or IsAdmitted) admits the query or named metric; list_metrics always passes and filters names by IsAdmitted.

terminals.outcome: The backend request is issued; backend failures are returned in the result Error field.
The result Error field carries the fixed capability-denied message; no backend call is made and no subject id or gate reason is echoed.
The result Error field carries the metric-access denial message.
The result Error field carries the range guardrail violation message.

decision_trees.fail_closed: Every telemetry tool checks the cluster-wide Telemetry capability at call time before any backend call; discovery is not relied on. A key-filtered allow is refused. With no access gate registered the capability check admits, matching the authorization-off default.

nodes.check: LatticeCredentialContext is active.
Resolution cache has a fresh subject.
A registered authenticator CanHandle returns true.
Authenticator returns a principal.
Group merge mode requires directory groups.

terminals.outcome: The caller resolves to LatticeSubject.Anonymous.
The principal maps to a LatticeSubject without a directory group merge.
The principal maps to a LatticeSubject with directory groups merged.
The cached subject is returned.

decision_trees.fail_closed: No credential, no handler, invalid token, or unmapped principal resolves to LatticeSubject.Anonymous.

nodes.check: Tenant rate limiter accepts the operation.
A warm tenant usage view exists.
TenantQuotaEvaluator admits every bounded dimension.

terminals.outcome: The request proceeds.
The operation is admitted because the tenant usage view is not yet warm.
The operation is refused with LatticeQuotaExceededException.

decision_trees.fail_closed: Quota breaches throw LatticeQuotaExceededException; unknown or not-yet-warm tenants admit until the first sample lands.

nodes.check: Tree owner is platform-owned or equals active tenant.

terminals.outcome: The tree id is excluded from the enumeration.
The tree id is included in the enumeration.

decision_trees.fail_closed: An uninitialized tenant owns no tenant trees and observes only platform-owned ids.

nodes.check: Tenant id is initialized.
Registry read succeeds and tenant record exists.

terminals.outcome: The tenant region visibility map is projected from the registry record.
Visibility resolves to Unresolved and every region lookup misses.

decision_trees.fail_closed: Unknown standing resolves to Unresolved rather than a permissive topology.
